assumptions.Model_target: 'whole_body'. Methods 2.3.4 describes BOTH whole-animal imaging at 6 h AND ex-vivo heart/liver/spleen/lung/kidney on the same instrument; neither the Fig 5C caption nor the text says which ROI the histogram plots. whole_body is the defensible reading for one number per lipid, but it is a reading.
assumptions.Route_of_administration: 'intravenous'. Methods 2.3.4 says only 'post-vaccination'; IV / tail-vein comes from the Fig 5 caption and the body text, which agree with each other.
assumptions.Dialysis_buffer: 'citrate' - faithful to Methods 2.3.3 (0.01 M citric acid pH 6, 2 h) but a category the corpus has never carried; every other source dialyses into PBS or saline.
assumptions.Dose_ug_nucleicacid: absent from the paper; left blank, not imputed.
assumptions.N_to_P_ratio: absent from the paper; the corpus has no column for it.
